scope: Retire the post-NGE Game Update 10 four-map queued/warped/level-gated battlefield system while preserving the PRE-CU open-world battlefield implementation, faction standing, mission terminals, and later-zone scenery assets.

findings: The pinned Publish 14 reference creates open-world battlefield markers and no-build/no-spawn active areas on eight original planets; it has no four-map cross-server queue, invitation, warp, level-75 admission, or token-reward controller.
The later pvp_battlefields table names four queued maps, and systems.gcw.player_pvp enforces level 75, 4v4-to-16v16 queue/invitation flow, warp admission, scoreboards, and battlefield tokens.
The retained systems.battlefield implementation is a distinct open-world region game using battlefield.tab, faction selection, battlefield structures, and PRE-CU faction-standing rewards.
The retained War Terminal still exposed a queue action after the queued player handler was detached, leaving a dead interaction and a cached intelpad action that could survive older sessions.
